Hi Hamman,

Thanks for coming back to me, and sorry you're still chasing this.

Here's where it stands. ···· was the $75 code we promised you for your Trustpilot review, and it was set to expire on September 30, so it stopped working before you ever got to use it. That's on us, not on you, and the code is being reissued for you.

The one thing I can't do is mint a $75 code myself, my own limit is lower than that, so a colleague is picking it up today. The team is offline right now and starts at 10am Eastern, and the new code comes to you by email at this address as soon as it's done. You don't need to do anything in the meantime.

A small tip so nothing slips again: once you have the new code, use it at checkout on the miner you want rather than holding it, since stock on the small units moves quickly. Your Thor X1 cart from last week is still live if that's the one.

Sorry again for the back and forth on this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

hence my urgency, thanks for your understanding.

Hi Hamman,

Update for you, and one piece of news you won't love.

The $75 code is with the team now and they are at their desks today, so the replacement code comes to you by email at this address. I can't mint a $75 one myself, that amount sits above my limit, which is the only reason this needs a colleague rather than me.

The news: the Hammer Thor X1 you had in your cart is showing sold out again as of today, and the 3x Bitaxe v2 bundle at $99 has come off the site entirely. So if the miner you meant is one of those two, that is what you're seeing. If it's a different unit that came back for Canada, tell me which one and I'll check the real warehouse stock for your region and tell you honestly whether it will hold.

In the meantime, the Hammer BC04 at $249 for 6 TH/s is the small unit we do have stock of. Not as low wattage as the X1, so I'm not pushing you toward it, just saying it's there.

Sorry you've had to chase this twice.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Thanks, you mentioned that amount sits above your limit. Can you offer
another discount in lieu?

Hi Hamman,

I'd rather not, and here's the honest reason.

Any code I can issue myself would be smaller than $75, and the system allows one code per customer record. So if I put a $25 one on now, it would get in the way of the $75 you were actually promised, and you'd end up worse off. The $75 stands, it hasn't been reduced or withdrawn, it just needs a pair of hands above mine to mint it.

The team is on until 6pm Eastern today and this is in front of them with the full history, including that you've been waiting since the start of September through no fault of your own. The code comes to this address.

If it somehow doesn't land today, reply here and I'll chase it again in the morning rather than leave you waiting a third time.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Having received no response in many days, I'd rather take a gamble on a
lower coupon before the miner sells out. Can you generate that Sarah? Not
sure if you're an AI bot but sounds like it, which is fine.

Hi Hamman,

Done. Your code is HD-••••••, $25 off, it belongs to you alone and it works on any order over $100. You can use it right now, so if the miner you want is back on the shelf, go ahead and grab it.

Straight with you on two things. First, your yes/no on the bot question: I'm the team's automated first line, and a person steps in when I can't do something, which is exactly what the $75 needs. Second, the $75 request stays open and the team picks it up when they start at 10am Eastern today, but I can't promise how they'll settle it once the $25 is used, so I don't want you counting on both.

Sorry it came to a gamble. You've been patient longer than anyone should have to be over a thank-you code.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
